title: INTRO TO FINANCIAL ENGINEERING
description: Prerequisite(s): IEOR E4106 or E3106 . Required for undergraduate students majoring in OR:FE. Introduction to investment and financial instruments via portfolio theory and derivative securities, using basic operations research/engineering methodology. Portfolio theory, arbitrage; Markowitz model, market equilibrium, and the capital asset pricing model. General models for asset price fluctuations in discrete and continuous time. Elementary introduction to Brownian motion and geometric Brownian motion. Option theory; Black-Scholes equation and call option formula. Computational methods such as Monte Carlo simulation.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( IEOR E3106 ) or ( IEOR E4106 )
